title: Introducing SWE-2: Pushing the Pareto Frontier
key_facts: Cognition introduced SWE-2, its most advanced coding model, on 8 Oct 2026.
It scored 50.0% on FrontierCode 1.1 Main, within one point of Fable 5.1 while being 64% cheaper, per Cognition.
Cognition says it beats SWE-1.7 and Grok 4.6 on both score and cost and comes within a few points of GPT-6 Astra at a quarter of the cost.
It is post-trained from Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter model, using reinforcement learning at multi-trillion-parameter scale.
The training adds a cost penalty so all reasoning-effort levels are trained in a single run.
SWE-2 medium scores higher than SWE-1.7 with 58% fewer turns and 81% lower cost on average on FrontierCode 1.1 Main.
Available from today in Devin Desktop and CLI; rolling out on Devin Web and Fusion.
quote_evidence: Today we’re introducing SWE-2, our most advanced coding model yet.
SWE-2 is available starting today in Devin Desktop and CLI.
We’re also rolling it out on Devin Web and Fusion.
why_it_matters_hint: A cheaper coding model near the top of reported performance could lower the cost of AI coding agents.
notes: Company blog post; all scores and cost comparisons are Cognition's own. Text shows 'Kimi K33' where a footnote number follows 'Kimi K3'; read as Kimi K3.
